text: The meta is still the Cherry deck, with the Melon Soda deck beside it. Every ≥2T forum lineup in Season 6 is one of the two.
detail: Scores differ by levels, runes, gear, stars, survival and retries, not cookie choice.

text: Levels steer Pomegranate's +69% beams: carries top the ATK order (Milk › Brightseeker › Skating Queen › Macaron › Tea Knight › Cheesecake), fillers sit at Lv.1.
detail: Scorpion holds 7th to catch stray beams. Order by ATK, not power, and check in battle: Octo Wasabi adds +8% when Scorpion enters.

text: Rank on damage, not on the 배 multiple. Pomegranate at Lv.1 doesn't add damage; it only lowers power and inflates the multiple.
Runes: Milk all ATK%; Brightseeker haste to 40–50 total with gear; Dark Choco haste; Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Macaron, Cheesecake, Tea Knight all skill amp.
detail: crumb.gg's rune optimizer, by the Season 6 #1, suggests the same on its sample account.

text: Raid gear: weapons skill amp + crit dmg, top-right haste + skill amp, armour DR + HP, bottom-right haste + DR. No move speed, accuracy, focus or crit res.
Best forum run with its lineup: 2T 204G, Cherry deck with levelled fillers, at 2.86G. Higher screens show no team.
detail: A Season 6 result shows 3T 257G with no lineup (dc:80426). The Season 5 #2's lobby shows 3T 045G with a no-move-speed Melon Soda deck at 4.23G (dc:76966).

text: Season 6's #1 reached 6T 276G; the rest of the top 10 sat at 4.2–4.9T. No top-10 team is published.
detail: Posters credit +20 and +25 plates and rune balance. The #1, crumb.gg's developer, credits stacked small optimizations plus money.

text: Past 2T, the carries outlive the 17 s wipe: every Season 6 forum screen above 2T does. It takes about 10M+ HP.
detail: The boss takes 70% then 90% less damage after 46 s, so how much survival adds is disputed: +300–600G per posters; a guide says take the wipe.

text: Among the top 50, score tracks setup more than raw account power.
detail: Season 6: score ÷ account power runs 76–164× (median 110×), and the top-power account (50.8G) placed #19. Account-wide, so not the forum's 배.

text: Expect hours of retries: one Cherry deck at 2.93G gave 208–783× over 100 runs, and 700×+ came once in 20.
detail: Records come from overnight macros. Near a setup's ceiling, retries buy little: two hours got the 1T 999G author +16G on 9/19.
